reason: A read-only DSH Web plugin that visualizes conversation fork lineage as a clickable git-style graph in the session header.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 会话头部以可点击的 Git 风格图形展示对话分叉历史。
summaries.en: Visualizes a DeepSeek Harness Web conversation’s fork history as a clickable Git-style graph in the session header.

capabilities: Reads the host session list and fork relationships
Renders a git-style fork graph in the session header
Navigates to a selected session when a graph node is clicked
